Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Remove and destroy affected leaves; apply neem oil spray every 5-7 days.
Tomato___Early_blight.dosage: Follow product label - typically every 7-10 days during active infection.

Tomato___Late_blight.organic: Improve air circulation, avoid overhead watering, remove infected plants immediately.
Tomato___Late_blight.dosage: As per product label - apply preventively in humid conditions.

Wheat___Leaf_rust.organic: Use resistant varieties in future planting; remove volunteer wheat plants.
Wheat___Leaf_rust.dosage: As per product label at first sign of rust pustules.

Cotton___Bacterial_blight.organic: Use certified disease-free seed; avoid working in fields when wet.
Cotton___Bacterial_blight.dosage: As per product label - typically every 10-14 days.
